svg.title: HydroSentinel: Sequence Diagram, draft a ticket with AI, repair it and verify it

g.text: HydroSentinel: Sequence Diagram, draft a ticket with AI, repair it and verify it
Open a report, press Draft with AI
load report, authority, contractors set up for it
Accept, start, mark fixed with a note
[step out of order or no note]
close ticket, resolve CitizenReport, INSERT AuditLog
